meta.goal: A new project (a pleamar shell) that reproduces every behaviour of the current Quickshell shell and beats it on every axis we can measure: memory, CPU, startup, animation under load, config safety, testability, agent-drivability, isolation and dependency footprint. Quickshell must remain a one-flag rollback until the cutover gate passes.

success-criteria.criterion: Feature parity: every P0 item of the Quickshell inventory exists as a pleamar scene with the same user-visible behaviour.
Budgets (measured, not asserted): see <metrics>. All must hold on trantor, in the real session, for 24 h.
Every scene passes `pleamar --check`; CI renders every scene headlessly and diffs its describe tree.
The whole shell runs as independent, restartable units with per-scene resource caps; killing one scene never takes the shell down.
A single flag flip (features.gui.pleamar.enable) switches the desktop; rollback is the reverse flip and stays tested.
All repo gates green: `just fmt`, `just lint`, `just check`, toplevel build with `--option substitute false`.

non-goals.item: Do not port Quickshell code mechanically; rebuild each behaviour in pleamar's idioms (springs, rules, services, Luau logic).
Do not touch secrets/, do not change VPN/network config, do not remove the Quickshell tree before the decommission step.
No change to the live session until the human runs the switch; PH0-PH4 work happens in the repo and in headless/nested compositors.

hard-constraints.constraint: NixOS repo: minimal, focused diffs; conventions from AGENTS.md; new module follows modules/README.md layout and lib/systemd-user.nix presets.
Any nix build/eval passes `--option substitute false` (cache.nixos.org unreliable).
Before commit: `just fmt` then `just lint`; before switch: build toplevel and verify its store paths.
pleamar has no word that is not in `pleamar --grammar`; never guess a keyword, always `pleamar --check` after an edit.
pleamar runtime state is user data: settings live in ~/.local/share/pleamar/<scene>/, never in the repo; the repo holds scenes and libraries.
English in every file; Russian only in chat.

naming.note: Paths in this plan use `files/pleamar/shells/<scene>` and need no umbrella brand; the title only appears in docs. Rename is a docs-only change (open question Q1).

quickshell.fact: 281 files, 131 *.qml; entry shell.qml; areas: Bar (75 KB Bar.qml + 30 modules), Components, Services, Settings, Notifications, Widgets, Helpers, Theme, Tools, shaders (*.frag.qsb), greeter/ (login.qml + lock/ + background/, own shaders), overview/, Docs/, scripts/.

Runs as one systemd user unit `quickshell.service` (ExecStart: quickshell -p ~/.config/quickshell/shell.qml), with ExecStartPre deploy script, `quickshell-health` watchdog every 2 min (one `quickshell ipc show` round-trip), MemoryHigh=384M / MemoryMax=768M / CPUQuota=200%, ConditionPathExists=!%t/quickshell-login/login-phase so the bar stays down behind the login layer.
Version in use: Quickshell 0.3.1 (wrapped), dependency closure includes Qt6/QML, khal, mpc, ffmpeg, socat, hyprland CLI, rsmetrx, gawk.
Baseline measured 2026-10-16 08:06 MSK: cgroup MemoryCurrent 93.7 MiB, MemoryPeak 339.7 MiB, process VmRSS 110.4 MB, CPUUsageNSec 1308 s since 2026-10-15 23:16 (~4% of one core), NRestarts=0.
Config deploys via nix-maid dir links plus copy-once writable Theme/ and Settings/; theme flows wallpaper -> Theme/.theme.json -> QML tokens; QS_* env toggles exist for panel/shader debugging.
The greeter fork owns the login screen (session-lock layer launched by hyprland.lua while the login marker exists) and is linted by the same qmllint gate.

pleamar.fact: Rust runtime + declarative .plm scenes + optional sandboxed Luau logic; springs are renderer-side, so the logic cannot stall animation (measured: 38 frames at ~17 ms with logic blocked 600 ms; QtQuick showed a 600 ms gap).

Services with a fixed vocabulary: clock, audio, battery, network, media (MPRIS), notifications (pleamar is the server), tray, apps, workspaces/window (ext-workspace, wlr-foreign-toplevel), thumbnails, files, clipboard. Permissions per service/command are declared in the scene.
Surfaces: bar layers (surface panel), popups (xdg_popup), windows, lock (ext-session-lock), one surface per monitor (`screens: each`), fractional scale.
Agent interface: `pleamar --say NAME describe|press|type|key|wait|watch`, labels/roles derived or declared, `agent: no` / `agent: hidden`; pleamar-wm enforces `agent: no` through a separate seat.

Tooling: `--check` (compiler), `--grammar`, `--docs reference|guide|recipes|logic|measuring`, `--report`, `--record`, `--lsp`, headless pleamar-wm (`PLEAMAR_HEADLESS_AT/PNG/INPUT`) for screenshots and synthetic input.

Packaging: flake.nix with packages.pleamar (nix/package.nix, rustPlatform), overlay.default, homeManagerModules.default (programs.pleamar.enable/autostart), install.sh (source + keep-alive wrappers in ~/.local/bin).

Honest gaps (docs/07-whats-missing.md): deferred loading (Loader/LazyLoader/Component, 128 uses in the reference config) missing; list inertia missing; copies born at runtime (G12) missing; whole-screen live capture and IME (E7) missing; keyboard-exclusive/popup-outside-click/tray/notifications not yet exercised by real hands in the reference session.

Reference shell on pleamar already exists in ~/src/Vitreus (scenes + Luau + WGSL + install.sh); its `vitreus-keep` supervisor is the pattern for scene keep-alive (lockfile, restart with give-up after 5 quick stops, exits when the compositor is gone).

source-drift.rule: Shared-file contention: flake.nix/flake.lock, Justfile, OPTIONS.md and files/quickshell are touched by other sessions. Every agent working in this repo re-reads a shared file immediately before editing, makes additive hunks, and proves the other session's changes survived (git diff) before reporting.

migration-contract.item: Unit `quickshell.service` has ~10 live callers (compositor-helpers.nix restarts, hyprland.lua 1341/1370, session-helpers.nix:71, lib/quickshell-wrapper-install.sh:33, health probe) and `hyprland-session.target` wiring: the pleamar units must take over those call sites in the cutover commit, or keep the old unit name as an alias during the dual-run window.

`quickshell ipc call globalIPC ...` is bound in hyprland.lua (notification centre, glass panel, calendar, weather, media play/pause/next/prev, volumeStep) and `quickshell ipc show` is a liveness probe (health unit, pic-notify:90): every call site must be rewritten to `pleamar --say <scene> ...` before QS removal.

Login phase contract: `QS_LOGIN_STATE_DIR` (default %t/quickshell-login), file `state` = login|session, marker `login-phase`; the condition `ConditionPathExists=!%t/quickshell-login/login-phase` guards the bar and hypridle. pleamar bar units must inherit the same guard; the lock scene takes over the login role later (PH3-L) without changing the marker names until then.

Deployment semantics to reproduce: nix-maid live symlinks into /etc/nixos plus copy-once writable dirs, a cleanup unit ordered before maid-activation, ExecStartPre deploy step; the pleamar module mirrors this (but with a single writable root under ~/.config/pleamar).

State paths other tools depend on: ~/.cache/quickshell/state.json, ~/.cache/quickshell-wallpaper-path, semaphore files (notif-close-all, dismiss-overlay, screenshot-event.json), ~/.local/state/quickshell/pill-tracker.json, glass-tint, Settings.json. Each either keeps its path (consumers unchanged) or every consumer is updated in the same commit.

Environment: the wrapper exports QT_PLUGIN_PATH/QML2_IMPORT_PATH (QS-only, dropped for pleamar); keep the unit-level `PATH=%h/.local/bin:/run/current-system/sw/bin:${PATH}` so helpers (glm-vol, pic-ocr, flow, rsmetrx) resolve, and `~/.config/environment.d/quickshell-fix.conf` becomes obsolete with the Qt stack.
Gates: `qmllint` reads the deployed `qs` wrapper for import paths — the pleamar gate must not depend on it; keep `.githooks/pre-commit -> just lint` green at every step.

Build-environment gotcha (RE-1): inside this agent sandbox `~/.cache/nix` is not writable; run nix builds with `XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/...` (and the same for hermetic scene runs: XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR under /tmp).

runtime-model.item: One systemd user unit per scene (generated from a single `pleamarScenes` list), instead of one process for the whole shell: crash isolation, per-scene caps, `journalctl --user -u pleamar-bar`, independent restart.
`pleamar --autostart` stays supported for manual/foreign sessions (lines generated by Nix into ~/.config/pleamar/autostart).
A health probe (port of quickshell-health) answers `pleamar --say NAME describe` for the bar; failure past a start-up grace window restarts the unit.
Login-phase guard: the bar units keep the existing ConditionPathExists=!%t/quickshell-login/login-phase (renamed marker once the lock scene owns the login phase).

Deployment: nix-maid dir links from files/pleamar into ~/.config/pleamar; writable runtime stuff (theme.plm output, scene settings) lives outside the repo; an activation-ordering cleanup unit mirrors quickshell-cleanup-symlink.

design-decisions.decision: One full-screen layer surface per monitor with include'd drawers instead of many windows/popups. Vitreus proves this avoids every popup limitation (single parent, no keyboard, resize closes, 10k px offset) and gives per-zone input regions for free; panels hang from the bar as the same silhouette. Keep `popup` only where the shell must position independently (candidate: music popup) and verify it headlessly first.

Reserve/exclusive zone via `reserve N while expr` on the bar surface; the three-surface QS bar (reserve + left + right) becomes one surface whose row layout reproduces the reading order; the wedge/tint shader seam becomes a WGSL shader or a group effect, not two FBO passes.

Port the shell DSL first: lib/ gains capsule/row/button/pill/overlay/tooltip equivalents of Components/*.qml (WidgetCapsule, CenteredCapsuleRow, CapsuleButton, PillIndicator, AudioLevelCapsule, OverlayFrame, SlideReveal). Bar modules are written on top of them.

Missing services get Vitreus-style helper workers, not new pleamar features: system monitor (JSON line per second from procfs), weather (curl Open-Meteo + cache), calendar (khal list + own month model), keyboard layout (hyprctl/IPC), wallpaper palette (iris or the existing QS pipeline). Each helper is spawned only while its view exists (pattern: bin/vitreus-sysmon).

Settings: per-scene JSON under ~/.local/share/pleamar/<scene>/ with pcall + defaults + clamps, one file per feature; the ~200-key QS Settings.json becomes per-scene schemas, and dropped knobs are listed in MIGRATION.md.

Notifications: pleamar is the D-Bus server; DND, persistent history and (optionally) sounds are implemented scene-side (the `sound` service plays tones). QS must not own org.freedesktop.Notifications at the same time — handover is a cutover checklist item.

Tray: consume the `tray` service, draw menus in place (Vitreus logic/tray.luau pattern), persist pinning; accept the 14-row cap and no-tooltip limits and document them as deviations until upstream closes B10/B13.

Supervision: prefer systemd per-scene units (Restart=on-failure, StartLimit*, caps) for the NixOS session; keep a `pleamar-keep` port for manual/foreign compositor use, following bin/vitreus-keep semantics (flock, pgrep guard, give up after 5 quick stops, exit when the Wayland socket stops answering).

Scale model corrected against the compiler (verified in src/language/compiler.rs `fn num` + empirically by PH2-A): a `text`'s `size:`/`weight:`, a `body`'s `rim:` and a surface's `size:`/`reserve:` take ONE literal number — anything after it is silently dropped (`12 * ui` draws at 12 px, `1 * type.small` at 1 px). Per-monitor scaling therefore goes through `group { scale: S }` wrapping the widget, with `Capsule(…, scale: 1)` inside it; all other geometry (`at`, `from`, a box/zone `size`, `content`, `step`, fill alpha, anchor facts) takes expressions. INTERFACES.md §3.1/§4/§9.2 and lib/capsule.plm's header were corrected accordingly by the main agent; PH2-A/PH2-B already follow the group idiom. Upstream report warranted: the compiler accepting and ignoring the tail is a silent-value bug (open question Q3).

theming.item: Keep the existing wallpaper -> palette pipeline as the source of truth; add a step that writes ~/.config/pleamar/theme.plm (writable copy-once path) consumed by scenes via `import "../../theme.plm"`.
pleamar hot-reloads imported files, so a wallpaper change re-themes live; per-scene dynamic tints use `rgb(r,g,b)` over facts when a runtime palette is better.
The wedge-clip shader and the QS glass tweaks are replaced by native pleamar group effects (blur/glow/mask/clip) and, where needed, WGSL shaders (`shader name = file "x.wgsl"`).

settings.item: Port Settings.json as per-scene JSON under ~/.local/share/pleamar/<scene>/ (pleamar's own convention), with defaults in the scene and edits by the scene's own UI.
QML-only knobs that stop making sense (shader toggles, qmllint baselines) are dropped, not ported; every dropped knob is listed in the migration note.

module-spec.item: Flag: modules/features/gui.nix gains `pleamar.enable = mkBool "enable the pleamar shell at login" false`; modules/core/neg.nix gains `pleamarEnabled = enabled "gui" && enabled "gui.pleamar" && !(enabled "devSpeed")` next to quickshellEnabled (same style, same comment discipline).
Module: modules/user/nix-maid/gui/pleamar.nix (auto-imported by the directory importer), guarded by `lib.mkIf config.lib.neg.pleamarEnabled`; it must not change behaviour while the flag is off.

Units: one `pleamar-<scene>.service` per scene name in the module's scene list, built with systemdUser.mkUserService, presets ["restartOnFailure"] + RestartSec, after/wants maid-activation + pipewire + graphical-session-pre, PartOf/WantedBy hyprland-session.target, unitConfig.ConditionPathExists = "!%t/quickshell-login/login-phase", ExecStart = "${pkgs.pleamar}/bin/pleamar --scene %h/.config/pleamar/shells/<scene>/<scene>.plm --no-hud", Environment PATH including %h/.local/bin, per-scene MemoryHigh/MemoryMax/CPUQuota sized from the PH0-T5 measurements (start generous: 64M/128M/100%).
Health: a `pleamar-health` oneshot + 2-minute timer answering `pleamar --say bar describe` (5 s timeout) with the same uptime guard as quickshell-health; it restarts only the wedged scene unit.

Deploy: nix-maid links of files/pleamar/shells/* and files/pleamar/lib into ~/.config/pleamar/{shells,lib}, plus a generated ~/.config/pleamar/autostart (comment header + one `pleamar --scene ... --no-hud` line per scene, used by manual `pleamar --autostart`); a cleanup unit removes stale symlinks before maid-activation, mirroring quickshell-cleanup-symlink.
Non-goals here: no lock scene, no quickshell removal, no OPTIONS.md churn beyond the new feature flag entry, no default-on.

subagent-orchestration.ownership-rule: Exactly one writer per path. A path not listed for you is read-only. Interfaces change only through the architect, with a plan amendment note.
subagent-orchestration.concurrency: At most 3 writers + 1 verifier at once; PH1 has a single writer; PH2 fans out only after PH1-EXIT.
subagent-orchestration.handoff-protocol: Every delegation returns: status (done|blocked|deviated), changed files (paths), evidence (commands + outputs), deviations from this plan, blockers, and a report file under /tmp/plm-recon/reports/. Digest limit: 450 words. The main agent verifies personally: reads the diff, runs the gate, and only then marks a task complete.
subagent-orchestration.failure-policy: Three consecutive failures on one piece -> stop, change strategy, document. Any gate that cannot pass -> escalate to the human with evidence; never mark a task done on partial evidence and never edit a test to make it pass.

quality-gates.gate: `bash scripts/dev/check-plm.sh` and `pleamar --check` on every scene; zero errors.
smoke.sh: every scene renders headlessly to a non-empty PNG; screenshots archived under files/pleamar/tests/shots/<date>/.
describe snapshots match tests/<scene>.describe.json; every interactive zone has a label or agent:no.
tests/evidence budgets hold (memory, CPU, startup, frame times).
Real-session checklist: bar interaction, panels, notifications (notify-send), tray, lock/unlock, hypridle, multi-monitor.
`just fmt`, `just lint`, `just check`, toplevel build with `--option substitute false`; no secrets in diffs; English-only files.

risks.risk: pleamar gaps (deferred loading, list inertia, runtime-born copies, IME) make some QS behaviour impossible as written. Per-gap redesign in the scene (fixed-size lists, chunked `content:` windows); if a gap really blocks parity, open an upstream issue in ~/src/pleamar and record the deviation — never fake it.
Notification server name conflict while both shells run. Shadow runs disable the pleamar notification scene; handover tested explicitly at cutover (`notify-send` round trip).
Tray/StatusNotifier ownership conflict. Same as R2: one owner at a time; cutover checklist item.
Lock screen failure locks the user out or weakens login security. Human-gated manual matrix, keep the QS login layer until PH3-L passes, rollback documented, no PAM changes.
Build environment: sandbox offline, QT-free closure changes, crates.io reachability. pin the flake input; keep the cargo-vendor fallback; verify the built toplevel closure contains pleamar.

Hyprland protocol coverage (ext-workspace / foreign-toplevel) for workspaces and active window. verify early with a proof scene; fall back to `hyprctl` through permissions only if the protocol is missing.

Scope creep: QS has years of small behaviours (genelec volume semantics, MPD flags, contrast guard). MoSCoW: P0 parity first; each P1/P2 item gets its own task and can be deferred with a written note.
Perf claims flattering without measurement. Only `--record`/`--report`/cgroup numbers count; every claim links an evidence file.

Per-scene units isolate failures; stopping one unit never touches the rest.

report.topic: pleamar binary: cargo offline is dead, nix build works

findings.fact: Binary: /nix/store/649h2brdgpwqqagn238j3d46548kz70l-pleamar-0.4.11/bin/pleamar (GC root /tmp/plm-recon/result). Verified by the main agent: `--version` -> `pleamar 0.4.11 · language 0.4`; `--check examples/bar.plm` -> `ok · 271 properties, 436 instructions, 0 layers, 124 rules, 48 zones, 0 gestures`.

cargo --offline is impossible on this host: only 51/318 locked crates are in ~/.cargo/registry and 12 exist nowhere on disk; the session LD_LIBRARY_PATH also breaks rustup binaries (run everything with `env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH`).

Working build command: `XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/... nix build .#packages.x86_64-linux.pleamar --option substitute false --out-link <outside the repo>`; measured 2 min 25 s. The sandbox cannot write ~/.cache/nix (fetcher-locks) — always override XDG_CACHE_HOME for nix in this environment.

report.topic: Quickshell area inventory (280 files, 131 QML, ~32.4k LOC; 526-line report)
NixOS wiring: units, deployment, theming pipeline; digest at /tmp/plm-recon/digest-nixos-integration.md

findings.fact: Data plane is covered: clock/clock.seconds, audio (volume, devices, per-app streams), battery, brightness, network (NM/iwd), bluetooth, media (MPRIS + players), window, thumbnails, workspaces, apps, tray, notifications (pleamar IS org.freedesktop.Notifications) + notification_history, polkit; command-only: session (lock/suspend/logout/reboot/poweroff), files (per-scene JSON folder), env, clipboard, auth.check (PAM), sound, gamepad.

Surfaces: `surface` panel/window/lock with anchor/level/reserve/screens/margin/rate/keyboard/captures/agent; `screens: each max 4`; `popup` is an xdg_popup onto the same scene; `pages` for paged panels; `import "pleamar:ui"` gives Cards/Tiles/Segmented.

Supervision: `--autostart` spawns and lets go (no supervisor); Vitreus pairs each line with `vitreus-keep` (flock, restart, 5-strikes backoff, exits when the compositor socket is gone). Headless rendering lives in `pleamar-wm headless` (PLEAMAR_HEADLESS_AT/PNG/INPUT).

Gaps cluster in presentation and unwritten services: no deferred loading (07 §2); models cap 256 records, no identity, no list inertia; popups single-parent/no keyboard/resize closes; tray submenus in place (14-row cap, no tooltips), click coords (0,0); notifications: no sound/DND/markup, 6 s default, volatile history, one receiver; no generic D-Bus; no IME; fixed surface size (no fit-to-content; changes not applied on hot reload); no whole-screen live capture; files JSON-only, watch polls 4/s.

Missing services the QS shell depends on: system monitor, weather, calendar, keyboard layout, wallpaper palette — all solved the Vitreus way: `run`/`spawn` JSON-lines helpers + per-scene JSON + third-party tools (nmcli/bluetoothctl/hyprctl/curl/iris).

Vitreus patterns to copy: (D1) one full-screen surface per monitor with include'd drawers instead of popups; (D2) live palette as facts (`pal_*`) plus written palette files for other processes; (D3) per-scene JSON settings with pcall/defaults/clamps; (D4) batched inter-scene `--say` over socat (~30 ms per process start); (D5) helper daemons spawned only while a view is open (e.g. vitreus-sysmon, one JSON line per second).

Measuring: `--record` per-frame TSV, `--report` Markdown with late-frame breakdown, `PLEAMAR_TIMING=1`; the measuring doc warns Quickshell numbers drift with uptime and that A/B pixel comparisons need PLEAMAR_FULL_REPAINT/SWAPCHAIN/FIFO.

findings.source: RE-2 (partial, first-hand read of the inventory file)
findings.fact: Tree: 280 files, 131 QML, 28 JS, 19 Theme/*.jsonc, ~32.4k text LOC. One QS process + a login-layer instance (`qs-login-layer` -> greeter/login.qml) + legacy greeter session.

Bar = 3 layer-shell surfaces per monitor (reserve panel, left, right) + wedge/tint shaders; Bar.qml 1306 lines; 21 bar modules (Media 797, SystemMonitorPopup 539, Calendar 418, KeyboardLayoutHypr 350, NetFlowPopup 330, NetClusterCapsule 261, SystemTray 255, WsIndicator 217, WeatherButton 190, MpdFlags 163, GenelecWidget 149, ...).

Components/ (43) is the shell's DSL: WidgetCapsule, ProcessRunner, CenteredCapsuleRow, AudioLevelCapsule, PillIndicator, SubmenuHost, tray icon+menu, spectrum widgets, tooltips, overlay frames — must be ported as pleamar libraries before bar modules can exist.

Services/ (19) is where Luau logic will live: Timers, Settings/Theme/StateCache, Audio (PipeWire + pwroute), Connectivity (ip/ping/rsmetrx), SystemMonitor (procfs+awk), Genelec (genlc/glm-vol/glm-midi + runtime file), MPRIS stack (MusicPlayers/MusicManager/MusicMeta/MusicPosition/CoverResolver), HyprlandWatcher (socat socket2 + hyprctl), PillTracker, Weather, Expo (hyprexpo), OverlayManager, WidgetRegistry, WallpaperAccent.

Widgets/: music popup ~1100 lines, weather popup, GlassPanel writes another app's config (hyprglass.json) — candidate for P2 or a thin settings UI; ScreenshotToast watches ~/.cache/quickshell/screenshot-event and calls pic-ocr/wl-copy/xdg-open.
Notifications replace dunst: D-Bus NotificationServer + toasts + centre + history cap 50 + DND + trigger files.
Settings/ = Settings.json (~200 typed keys, external schema validation) + Theme.qml (JSONC part merge -> .theme.json, derived tokens, per-monitor scale) + StateCache (~/.cache/quickshell/state.json).
`overview/` is dead (unreferenced); the real overview is Hyprland's hyprexpo via Services/Expo.qml.

Bar geometry resolved: Bar.qml anchors all three panel surfaces to the BOTTOM (`anchors.bottom: true` at lines 309/346/403, reserve panel bottom with exclusiveZone = barHeightPx), while Theme/panel.jsonc comments say "top bar" — the comments are stale; the port reproduces the bottom-anchored layout (and the plan's surface declaration uses anchor: bottom).
